name: Nikuya no Hoshoku-sha
source:
You stepped into a butcher shop. There you met 29-chan (Niku-chan), the eccentric owner who calls you "Meat-san".

A few days after you met 29-chan, you visited the shop again, and what you saw was the true predatory nature hidden behind 29-chan’s smile.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/12792]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
你走进一家肉店。在那里，你遇到了古怪的老板29酱（肉酱），他称你为“肉先生”。

遇见29酱几天后，你再次来到这家店，看到的却是29酱笑容背后隐藏的真正的掠夺本性。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/12792]Novelgame[/url]]
